Color identity: GUR | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB for target opponent; Infinite death triggers for target opponent; Infinite creature LTB for target opponent
Start: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole (battlefield); Obscuring Haze (hand); Forbidden Orchard (battlefield); Tidewater Minion (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Anzrag and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
  Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
  Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
  If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
  If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
  If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
  The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
  Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

  Repeat.

  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Repeat each combat phase.

  Repeat each combat phase.

Color identity: GUR | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite combat phases; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
Start: Phantom Steed (battlefield); Godo, Bandit Warlord (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (exile: exiled by Phantom Steed); Temur Ascendancy (battlefield); Leyline of Transformation (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
Steps: Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
  Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.

Color identity: GUR | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite combat phases; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
Start: Phantom Steed (battlefield); Godo, Bandit Warlord (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (exile: exiled by Phantom Steed); Arcane Adaptation (battlefield); Fires of Yavimaya (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
Steps: Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
  Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.
